parameters.content:
## alice-mail-attachment-backfill

PROJ-53: imports attachments of already-indexed Weaviate `Email` objects into
the DMS target folders under /mnt/nas/ai/<Schema>/.

**Trigger**: POST /webhook/alice-mail-attachment-backfill
**Already-imported detection**: deterministic filename pattern
`<YYYY-MM-DD>_<sender-shortform>_<original-name>` (+ `_N`) in any of the five
schema folders — no tracking table (per Tech-Entscheidungen).
**Progress**: { processed, imported, skipped_no_match, failed, remaining }
**Lock**: shares `alice:dms:processor:lock:run` with alice-dms-processor.
**Safe to re-run**: already-present files are skipped, so runs are resumable.
Unreachable mailboxes (IMAP error / deleted / changed password) are skipped + logged.

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { reason: 'lock_busy', error: 'alice-mail-attachment-backfill: lock busy - alice-dms-processor or another backfill run is currently active. Try again later.' } }];

parameters.query: SELECT id::text, imap_host, imap_port, imap_username, password_enc, ssl_enabled FROM alice.imap_mailboxes
